name: Mbed TLS
pruning: Unused upstream programs/tests and framework data removed. Guarded library/source groups, generated release sources, upstream CMake files and licenses retained unchanged.
releaseVsGit: Official source release changes GEN_FILES default to OFF in both root CMake files and updates generated-file .gitignore entries. All matched C/header source blobs equal pinned git trees; official archive SHA is primary retained-byte authority.
symlinkPolicy: Upstream symlinks resolving within this pinned tree are stored as regular files with the same ledger-verified contents for portable source inventory. No source bytes change.
